summary: Full stack testing (iteration 12) covering CORRECTIF A (auto-naming empty zone), templates de logement, historique de température (backend+frontend), et bannière d'alertes. 10/10 pytest backend tests pass. UI tests confirm all P2 features working.
critical_code_review_comments: AlertsBanner: 5% offline chance per device per sync is quite low; test/QA path could be improved by exposing a POST /installations/{iid}/simulate/fault (dev-only) to force alerts deterministically instead of hammering /devices/sync.
temperature_history: `hours` param silently clamped to [6..72] like `count` in discover; consider 400 for out-of-range for cleaner client contract.

CreateInstallationDialog.submit: le compteur 'Zone N' démarre à 1 même si une zone nommée existe déjà; peut créer une collision (ex: 'Zone 1' entré manuellement puis auto 'Zone 1' généré). Non bloquant, mais mérite un dédoublonnage.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_CreateFix_A, TEST_TemplateMaison, TEST_TemplateStudio (pytest cleanup fixture) and TEST_UI_Maison, TEST_UI_EmptyZone (UI); all deleted via /api/installations DELETE at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_history_and_create_fix.py covers: create-with-empty-zone (verified 3 zones + 3 thermostats + 1 gainable persist), templates studio/maison, history endpoint hours=24/48/72 (25/49/73 points) with per-zone_id keys, clamp <6 → 7 pts, clamp >72 → 73 pts, and 401 for unauthenticated. Frontend Playwright verified: template-maison fills 6 zone-rows and creates 6-zone install; empty 3rd zone auto-named 'Zone 1' on dashboard (screenshot); AlertsBanner absent when devices online with high battery; history-chart svg has one recharts .recharts-line per zone (3 lines for 3 zones) and legend with 3 items across 24/48/72h ranges. Note: forcing offline/battery alerts via repeated /devices/sync is probabilistic (5%) and 15 syncs did not deterministically trigger a banner — main agent might want a dev-only fault-injection endpoint for QA.
rca of the issue: N/A — this iteration is feature validation, no regression detected. CORRECTIF A works: submit() auto-nomme les zones vides via `counter += 1; return { ...z, name: 'Zone ${counter}' }` avant l'appel createInstallation, garantissant qu'aucun thermostat appairé n'est perdu.
